title: Recovered Centerstone spike and bloom geometry
precision: Float32 cylinder meshes; source parser recovers centerlines by averaging ring vertices. Segment/point keys use 6 decimal places, matching Audit 008/009. Not symbolic exact input.
units: Original GLB model units; no global or per-vertex rescaling of segment layers.

native.meaning: Unit-direction graph; radial lengths removed. Not the full rendered model's vertices.

G24_complete.meaning: Unit-direction graph; radial lengths removed. Not the full rendered model's vertices.

distinctions: The 362/626 point graphs retain directions only; use segment_layers for actual radii and spike tips.
Outer-shell and flower-lattice polylines are sampled curves, not additional structural junction claims.
Crossings in the render are not automatically registered graph vertices.
G24_added is an explicit extension of the native model.
